node.text: 2 Simple Ways to Create a New Apple ID on iPhone
A quick and easy guide to setting up a new Apple ID on your iPhone

Do you want to make a new Apple ID for your iPhone or iPad? You can use an Apple account to access all of Apple's services, such as iCloud, the App Store, and more. To create an account, you'll need a valid phone number. This wikiHow will show you how to create a new Apple ID using the Settings app and App Store on your iPhone or iPad.
You'll need a valid email address and phone number to create a new Apple ID.
When using the Settings app, tap "Sign in to your iPhone", then "Create Apple ID".
When using the App Store, click the profile icon, then click "Create New Apple ID".
